name: Administrative systems
summary: Access business applications, HR tools and enterprise systems

details.title: Employee applications
details.html: York administrative systems include HR Self-Serve, Halo, finance applications, Maximo, Student Information System tools and ARMS. Access is tied to your York affiliation and may require specific role authorization

details.title: HR Self-Serve
details.html: HR Self-Serve provides active employees with pay statements, tax slips, personal information, benefits information, training profiles and applicable time or absence reporting functions. Some tools vary by employee category

details.title: Finance and service management
details.html: Authorized employees can access finance applications such as Concur and budgeting systems. Halo provides an enterprise IT service-management portal for support requests and related processes
